en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a grand neoclassical building with a central portico supported by columns and a tall tower above. The facade has evenly spaced windows framed by pilasters, and there is a statue in front as well as an ornate fence along the foreground. Faint postal cancellation wavy lines appear across the sky area. At the bottom, printed text identifies the location in Latvian.
